sections.heading: ITC India Pvt Ltd
paragraphs: Ensure REACH Compliance for Smooth EU Market Access – Expert Services from ITC India Pvt Ltd

If you’re manufacturing or exporting chemical substances or products into the European Union, compliance with REACH Regulation (EC 1907/2006) is mandatory. At ITC India Pvt Ltd, we provide comprehensive technical assistance for the same, enabling your business to meet European regulatory standards with ease.

sections.heading: 🌍 What is REACH Certification?
paragraphs: REACH stands for Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation, and Restriction of Chemicals. Managed by the European Chemicals Agency (ECHA), it governs the production and use of chemical substances in the EU.

sections.heading: The regulation applies to
bullets: All sectors including chemicals, electronics, cosmetics, automotive, and textiles
Companies that import over 1 tonne of chemical substances annually into the EU

sections.heading: 🏢 Why Choose ITC India Pvt Ltd?
paragraphs: With over 20 years of regulatory expertise, ITC India Pvt Ltd offers end-to-end REACH compliance services, including technical documentation, risk assessment, and Only Representative (OR) liaison.
